title: Concerto No. 2
identity: Walter S. Hartley’s Concerto No. 2 is a 1989 alto saxophone concerto. The Hartley estate catalog gives a small orchestra or piano option, 10:30 duration, and Dorn publication, catalog no. 173. Dorn’s 2025 catalog separately lists Concerto #2 for alto saxophone and small orchestra as DP431, score and parts. A 1989 Saxophone Journal excerpt is bibliographically listed by an UPV dissertation.

evidence.claim: Hartley estate catalog lists Concerto No. 2 (1989), alto saxophone, small orchestra or piano, 10:30, Dorn, no. 173.
evidence.source_name: Walter S. Hartley estate, saxophone works catalog

evidence.claim: Dorn Publications 2025 catalog lists Concerto No. 2 as alto saxophone and small orchestra, score and parts, item DP431 (printed p. 24). Its listing does not specify a piano part.

The UPV dissertation bibliography cites a Saxophone Journal excerpt from Concerto No. 2 for Alto Saxophone by Walter Hartley, vol. 14, no. 2, September/October 1989 (printed p. 783). The excerpt itself was not accessed.
evidence.source_name: Universitat Politècnica de València dissertation bibliography

collection_flag: Composer-estate catalog confirms an alto-saxophone concerto with small orchestra or piano option. No pedagogical placement verified.
gaps: Full score and saxophone part were not obtained; note-level demands and exact piano-reduction contents remain unverified.
